---
name: Documentation issue
about: Report an error, ambiguity, or gap in Veylqorix documentation
title: 'docs: '
labels: documentation
assignees: soumyachk101
---

## Which doc?

File path (e.g. `README.md`, `docs/mcp.md`) and, if possible, the section or
line.

## What's wrong?

- [ ] Incorrect (facts, commands, or expected output are wrong)
- [ ] Ambiguous / hard to understand
- [ ] Missing information
- [ ] Broken link
- [ ] Out of date
- [ ] Accessibility issue

## Description

What should the doc say instead, or what is missing?

## Suggested fix

A concrete patch or rewording is very helpful.
